summary: MODEL_CHANGE_REQUIRED: RaftMsg::TransferLeader calls Engine::elect without the is_voter guard. Model, harness and Update.tla updated; 34/34 fresh traces validate; a learner transfer target panics its RaftCore (MC-1, reproduced, absent on baseline).
validation_limits: All clean model-checking results are budget-limited (30-min BFS plus 20-min simulation per campaign; nonempty queues), not proofs.
Lease timing, the transfer_leader metrics wait/timeout, follower log truncation/membership rollback, follower commit propagation and HigherVote notifications are not modeled.
RaftCore-level traces cover TransferLeader and vote request/response windows only; crash/restart around a transfer (U4) and post-transfer commit are model-checked but not trace-observed.
Built with stable cargo 1.100.0 because the pinned nightly-2024-03-20 toolchain is not installable offline.
The specula CLI is not installed: persistent-findings lookup/registration and `specula ci-result` were not run.

findings.title: TransferLeader to a learner makes it elect and panics its RaftCore (target not in quorum set)
findings.cause: RaftCore handles RaftMsg::TransferLeader by calling Engine::elect() when self.id == to after checking only vote == from, without the is_voter guard of every other election trigger; Candidate::grant_by panics when the non-voter candidate handles its own SaveVote self-grant.
findings.trigger: Call Raft::transfer_leader(leader_vote, to = learner that holds leader_vote, last_log_id) on the learner or on every node.
findings.consequence: The learner's RaftCore panics (Fatal::Panicked, node down); when called on every node the higher-term vote requests also depose the current leader. A removed node used as `to` elects without panicking and disrupts the cluster.

premises: A learner receives AppendEntries and holds the leader's committed vote.
transfer_leader does not validate that `to` is a voter.
SaveVote completion delivers the local self VoteResponse before remote responses.

findings.title: Persisted committed id can run ahead of the leader's durable log (pre-existing, not update-related)
findings.cause: With three voters the leader commits from two follower acks before its own flush, and SaveCommitted has no flush condition, so a persisted committed id may exceed the leader's durable log.
findings.trigger: Three-voter cluster; leader appends, followers ack, leader saves committed before its own append is flushed; crash before the flush.
findings.consequence: Unresolved: docs allow committed > flushed, but RaftState::validate requires committed <= last_log_id after restart; reachability depends on the storage's ordering of save_committed vs append flush.
